exposure: common obstetric and gynecological surgeries (cesarean section, hysterectomy)
cohort: The participants included 3,464 cases of cesarean section and hysterectomy, from which 45 patients for whom urology was consulted for suspected ureteral injury were reviewed from King Abdulaziz Medical City, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.
finding: The study found that the incidence of iatrogenic ureteral injury was relatively associated with older age.
